g.title: ABBAImplicitFullExecution
g.text: Horizontal: six phases from physical inputs to validated Solution. Vertical: operations and numerical details.
Blue: common contracts. Orange: method preparation. Green: numerical algorithm. Purple: optional observation.
m = physical state size; q = internal workspace size; T = requested samples. All module paths are repository-relative.

g.title: Potential
g.text: For GC: potential field, rho and normalization.
Other systems supply their own physical parameters.
Keep units, reproducible input data and seeds
The algorithm consumes the dynamics contract.

g.title: PhaseDefinition
g.text: Assemble problem, time request and method

g.title: Dynamics
g.text: Full mode requires exactly one GC particle.

g.title: Initial
g.text: Particle velocities come from the field.
No integration history is allocated here.

g.title: Problem
g.text: Require a finite initial state and

g.title: Layout
g.text: Components are packed in component-major order.
The same layout interprets saved physical history.

g.title: PhasePreparation
g.text: Initialize one numerical instance, state and resources

g.title: Request
g.text: The saved grid need not equal the step grid.

g.title: Runner
g.text: The public simulate(...) function delegates here.
Validate the three public input contracts.
The same call resumes in phase 06

g.title: Configuration
g.text: StatePolicy selects physical, tracked or full state.
Seven projected maps close the complete step.
One run chooses one compatible configuration.
Initialization builds its numerical resources once.

g.title: PhaseExecution
g.text: Descend into one complete numerical advance

g.title: Prepare
g.text: : None; resources are attributes of this instance.
Full mode requires exactly one GC particle.
new_run copies options into the same concrete class.
initialize sets the initial state and numerical resources.
Adaptive initialization creates the live solver once.

g.title: RunMethod
g.text: SAME NUMERICAL CLASS / ONE INSTANCE PER EXECUTION
No separate context or callback-based method record.
Construct another instance for another integration.
Completed runs cannot re-enter the global driver.
The collector and external observer own histories.

g.title: StateSpace
g.text: StatePolicy selects physical, tracked or full state.
Seven projected maps close the complete step.
Initialize before stepping; finish during advance.
Expose only physical coordinates in Solution.
Retain required auxiliary quantities as diagnostics.

g.title: Runtime
g.text: Create a fresh controller and IntegrationCollector.
Validate each accepted interval and state.
save requested samples; report temporal progress.
Merge metadata, metrics, auxiliary output and aliases.
No branch selects a numerical-method class.

g.title: FamilyResources
g.text: ABBA4 projects once around its complete composition.
Mathematical kernels remain in steps.py and projection modules.

g.title: PhaseRecords
g.text: Record basic metrics and optional observations

g.title: Grid
g.text: Yield StepInfo and run.advance(t, state, h).
Interior output: shortened advance from a copy
A shadow sample does not alter the main grid.
Its work is excluded from metrics and observations.
DOP853 and Radau supply a different controller.

g.title: Advance
g.text: Preserve the supplied state and fixed-map resources.
No main/shadow flag, history write or observer call.

g.title: ProjectedStep
g.text: statistics: mapping of scalar/vector work values.
StepInfo supplies index, times and input snapshot.
The collector copies only statistics and samples.
The method observation builder understands Detail.

g.title: StepRecipe
g.text: StatePolicy selects physical, tracked or full state.
Seven projected maps close the complete step.

g.title: Projection
g.text: Advance t_j by its signed duration.
The final outer time is t+h.

g.title: Nonlinear
g.text: Newton or Broyden; reduced or simultaneous.
A projected output becomes the next factor input.
Failure propagates to the common coordinator.
A failed run does not produce a successful Solution.

g.title: Maps
g.text: Each projected factor displaces copies by +/-mu,
applies four ABBA shears and solves diagonal closure.
Use the same selected formulation for all factors.
Negative factors keep their actual signed clocks.

g.title: Stages
g.text: One collector handles the complete run.
Only accepted states continue the main trajectory.
Output sampling does not replace accepted nodes.

g.title: Legend
g.text: Thick arrows between phase headers: overall lifecycle; phases 04 and 05 repeat together for each main step.
Thin solid arrows: calls or required data. Dotted blue arrows: returned values. Dashed purple arrows: optional events.
A hollow diamond means a record contains another record. Red dashed arrows indicate failure propagation.
Card subtitles distinguish actual APIs from inline operations and numerical contracts.
The method prepares and advances; the controller selects accepted intervals and samples them.
The common coordinator records, observes and exports; the per-run collector owns history.
Method-specific Detail never becomes an implicit event history. Optional observers own analysis and persistence.
Fixed methods retain their fixed-step algorithms. DOP853 and Radau retain their adaptive numerical sessions.

g.title: Recording
g.text: ONE RUN / REQUESTED SAMPLES + ACCEPTED METRICS
Copy metric rows with stable keys and shapes.
Never store method details or observer events.
Rejected adaptive trials have no accepted row;
their numerical work belongs to the accepted step.

g.title: EventBuilder
g.text: Only called when an observer is installed.
Use accepted details and independent snapshots.

g.title: PhaseOutput
g.text: Finalize, validate and interpret the trajectory

g.title: Data
g.text: extracts the physical state and optional energy.
Export never repeats the numerical projection.
Internal and physical dimensions may differ.
Return to the original SimulationRunner call.
Only the requested trajectory is exposed by default.

g.title: Events
g.text: An observer may analyze or retain records.
Default integration does not store event histories.

g.title: Failure
g.text: Stop the run; do not construct a successful
Retain method, time and solve context.

g.title: Snapshots
g.text: Changing an event must not change integration
state, samples, subsequent events or metrics.

g.title: DiagnosticFields
g.text: Seven substep columns; sums of iterations/evaluations.
Worst normalized residual and multiplier norm.

g.title: Resume
g.text: Require exactly the requested output times.
Check shape, finiteness and packed layout.
Verify that the initial state is preserved.

g.title: Solution
g.text: Owns copies of trajectory and diagnostic arrays.

g.title: Interpret
g.text: Solution carries physical samples and diagnostics.
Studies compose runs and reference comparisons.
do not by themselves establish trajectory accuracy.
